# Home Remedies Property Management & Real Estate

> Family-owned property management and real estate serving Westminster, Arvada, Thornton, Broomfield, Erie and the greater Denver metro since 2024. Full-service residential property management with transparent pricing and no-penalty, month-to-month management.

## About

Home Remedies Property Management and Real Estate Services is a family-owned company based in Westminster, Colorado, serving the north Denver metro. We manage single-family homes, townhomes, and small multi-family rentals, and also help clients buy and sell residential real estate. Our approach is owner-operated and personal: clients work directly with the people who manage their property.

- Phone: (303) 515-1352
- Email: homeremediespm@gmail.com
- Location: Westminster, CO 80031 (serving the north Denver metro and Boulder County)
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
- Founded: 2024
- Slogan: Where Excellence Meets Management

## Services

- [Property Management](https://www.homeremediespm.com/management.html): Full-service residential property management — tenant screening, leasing, rent collection, maintenance, and monthly owner reporting.
- [STR Management](https://www.homeremediespm.com/str-management.html): Short-term rental management for Airbnb, VRBO, and Booking.com — multi-platform listing, dynamic pricing, guest communication, and turnovers, for a flat 20% of booking revenue.
- [Buying & Selling](https://www.homeremediespm.com/buy-sell.html): Residential real estate services for buyers and sellers across the Denver metro.
- [Pricing](https://www.homeremediespm.com/pricing.html): Transparent management pricing with no-penalty, month-to-month agreements.
- [Free Rental Analysis](https://www.homeremediespm.com/free-rental-analysis.html): A real market rent figure for a specific property, based on comparable homes that actually leased. Free and no obligation.
- [Colorado Landlord Law Checklist](https://www.homeremediespm.com/colorado-landlord-checklist.html): Free printable checklist of Colorado landlord requirements: deposits, late fees, rent increases, eviction notices, disclosures, screening and city licensing.

## Guides

Owner-focused guides on Colorado landlord law, hiring a property manager, rental economics and north Denver metro rental markets. All articles are written by Nadir Maaiah, licensed Colorado real estate agent and co-owner.

- [1031 Exchanges for Colorado Rental Owners: The Basics](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-1031-exchange-colorado.html): Deferring capital gains by exchanging one investment property for another. The deadlines, the qualified intermediary requirement, and the mistakes that disqualify an exchange.
- [What Property Management Costs in Boulder County](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-boulder-county-property-management-cost.html): Typical fee structures across Boulder, Longmont, Louisville and Superior — and why Boulder properties legitimately cost more to manage than the rest of the county.
- [Boulder Occupancy Limits: How Many Tenants Are Allowed?](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-boulder-occupancy-limits.html): Boulder restricts unrelated occupancy by zoning and property. What the limits mean in practice, how enforcement works, and why the lease clause matters as much as the rule.
- [Boulder Rental License Requirements for Landlords (2026)](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-boulder-rental-license.html): Boulder has required rental licenses far longer than most Colorado cities, and it enforces them. What the license involves, how the inspection works, and the occupancy limits that catch out-of-town owners.
- [The Boulder Rental Market in 2026: An Owner's Report](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-boulder-rental-market-2026.html): What drives Boulder rents, why vacancy stays structurally low, how the academic calendar shapes leasing, and what an owner should realistically expect.
- [Short-Term Rental Rules in Boulder County: What Is Allowed](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-boulder-short-term-rental-rules.html): Licensing, primary-residence requirements, HOA prohibitions and lodging taxes. Why most Boulder County properties cannot lawfully be short-term rentals.
- [Breaking a Lease in Colorado: An Owner's Guide](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-breaking-a-lease-colorado.html): Early termination, the duty to mitigate, protected reasons a tenant may leave, and how to handle a break-lease request so it costs you the least.
- [Brighton & Commerce City Rental Market 2026](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-brighton-commerce-city-rental-market-2026.html): Current Brighton and Commerce City, CO rent data for 2026 — where both northeast-metro markets stand right now and how landlords should price this year.
- [Broomfield & Federal Heights Rental Market 2026](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-broomfield-federal-heights-rental-market-2026.html): Current Broomfield and Federal Heights rent data for 2026, why one market is holding steady while the other cools, and how landlords should price this year.
- [Colorado Eviction Notice: 3-Day, 10-Day & 21-Day Rules Explained](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-colorado-eviction-notice.html): Which eviction notice Colorado requires in each situation — pay-or-quit, lease violation, and ending a month-to-month tenancy — how long each period runs, and the service mistakes that force landlords to start over.
- [Colorado Eviction Process 2026: Timeline & Steps for Landlords](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-colorado-eviction-process.html): A clear, step-by-step guide to the Colorado eviction process in 2026 — realistic timelines, the notice-to-filing-to-sheriff sequence, the new just-cause rule, and the mistakes that restart the clock.
- [Colorado Fence Laws: Who Pays and Who Decides](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-colorado-fence-laws.html): Boundary fences, shared costs, the Colorado Fence Law, HOA rules and city height limits. What a rental property owner needs to know before touching a fence.
- [Colorado Landlord Tenant Law: What Landlords Must Know in 2026](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-colorado-landlord-tenant-law.html): A plain-English guide to Colorado landlord-tenant law in 2026 — just cause, notice periods, security deposits, habitability, rent increases and the rules that catch owners out. Written for landlords, not lawyers.
- [Colorado Late Fee Rules for Landlords: Limits and Grace Periods](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-colorado-late-fees-rent-rules.html): Colorado restricts residential late fees, when they may be charged and how they may be enforced. What owners can charge, and the mistakes that turn a small fee into a real liability.
- [Colorado Lease Agreement Requirements: What Must Be in It](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-colorado-lease-agreement-requirements.html): Required disclosures, prohibited clauses and the terms that decide whether your lease protects you. A practical guide to Colorado residential lease agreements for owners.
- [Colorado Rent Increase Laws: How Much & How Often in 2026](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-colorado-rent-increase-laws.html): How often Colorado landlords can raise rent, how much notice is required, why there is no rent control in Colorado, and how to raise rent without triggering turnover that costs more than the increase.
- [Colorado Rental License Requirements by City (North Metro Guide)](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-colorado-rental-license-by-city.html): Rental licensing rules change at every city line in the Denver metro. A practical overview of what to check in Denver, Boulder, Longmont, Westminster, Arvada, Thornton and the surrounding cities.
- [A Seasonal Maintenance Calendar for Colorado Rentals](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-colorado-rental-maintenance-calendar.html): Hail, swamp coolers, sprinkler blowouts, ice dams and radon. A Front Range-specific maintenance calendar that prevents the expensive failures rather than reacting to them.
- [Colorado Security Deposit Law 2026: Rules & Return Deadlines](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-colorado-security-deposit-law.html): A plain-English guide to Colorado security deposit law for landlords in 2026 — return deadlines, itemized deductions, penalties for withholding, and the new HB25-1249 fiduciary custodian rule.
- [Renting to CU Boulder Students: A Landlord's Guide](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-cu-boulder-student-rentals.html): Group leases, guarantors, the August cycle, occupancy limits and the wear profile. What student rentals in Boulder actually involve and whether the returns justify it.
- [Denver Residential Rental License: A Landlord's Guide (2026)](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-denver-rental-license.html): Denver requires a residential rental license for essentially every rented home in the city. What the license involves, why the inspection catches owners out, and what happens if you rent without one.
- [Denver Rental Market 2026: Rents, Vacancy & Landlord Outlook](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-denver-rental-market-2026.html): A plain-spoken look at the Denver rental market in 2026 — where rents stand, why apartments are cooling while single-family rentals hold steady, and what it means for your pricing.
- [Erie and Lafayette: Boulder County's Growth Corridor](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-erie-lafayette-rental-market.html): Two of the fastest-growing communities on the Front Range. New construction, commuter demand, HOA restrictions and what owners should expect from each.
- [Evicting a Tenant With No Lease in Colorado: How It Works](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-eviction-no-lease-colorado.html): No written lease does not mean no tenancy. How Colorado treats month-to-month and at-will occupants, what notice you must give, and the special cases — family members, holdover tenants and guests who never left.
- [Firestone & Frederick Rental Market 2026](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-firestone-frederick-rental-market-2026.html): Current Firestone and Frederick, CO rent data for 2026 — why the numbers vary so much by source in these two Weld County towns, and how to price against it.
- [First-Time Landlord Mistakes: 9 to Avoid When Renting a House](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-first-time-landlord-mistakes.html): First-time landlord in Westminster, Arvada, or the Denver metro? Avoid the 9 most common mistakes new landlords make — screening, pricing, leases, compliance, budgeting, and more.
- [Golden, Lakewood & Wheat Ridge Rental Market 2026](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-golden-lakewood-wheat-ridge-rental-market-2026.html): Current rent data for Golden, Lakewood, and Wheat Ridge, CO in 2026 — three west-metro markets at three different price points, and how to price against each.
- [HOA Rental Restrictions in Colorado: What Owners Must Check](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-hoa-rental-restrictions-colorado.html): Rental caps, minimum lease terms, waiting periods and approval requirements. What Colorado HOAs can restrict, what they cannot, and how to check before you commit.
- [How to Price Your Rental Right (and Cut Vacancy) in Denver (2026 Guide)](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-how-to-price-your-rental.html): How to price a Denver-metro rental in 2026 — the vacancy math that favors competitive pricing, why last year's rent is the wrong number, and how to pull accurate comps to cut vacancy and rent faster.
- [Is a Property Manager Worth It? When to Hire One in Denver](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-is-a-property-manager-worth-it.html): Is a property manager worth it? An honest, numbers-based guide for Denver-metro owners — what self-managing really costs, the signs it's time to hire, and how the fees pencil out.
- [Landlord Insurance in Colorado: Cost, Coverage & Hail Risk](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-landlord-insurance-colorado.html): What landlord insurance costs in Colorado, why premiums keep climbing along the Front Range, what a DP-3 policy covers that a homeowner's policy will not, and the coverage gaps that cost owners the most.
- [Landlord Right of Entry in Colorado: Notice and Access](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-landlord-right-of-entry-colorado.html): Notice requirements, emergencies, showings, inspections and the right of quiet enjoyment. How to get access without creating a claim.
- [Should You Put a Colorado Rental in an LLC?](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-llc-for-rental-property-colorado.html): Liability protection, the due-on-sale clause, financing consequences, transfer taxes and the insurance alternative. An honest look at whether an LLC is worth it.
- [The Longmont Rental Market in 2026: Where the Yield Is](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-longmont-rental-market-2026.html): Longmont offers materially better yield than Boulder while drawing on much of the same regional demand. What drives the market, who rents here, and what to expect.
- [Louisville and Superior Rentals After the Marshall Fire](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-louisville-superior-rental-market.html): Two of Colorado's most consistently top-rated towns, reshaped by the Marshall Fire. What the rebuild did to supply, who rents here, and what owners should know.
- [Month-to-Month Leases in Colorado: Pros and Cons](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-month-to-month-lease-colorado.html): Flexibility, notice periods, the just-cause requirement and when month-to-month makes sense. What Colorado's rules mean for a periodic tenancy.
- [Move-In and Move-Out Inspections: How to Do Them Right](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-move-in-move-out-inspection.html): A documented move-in condition report is what wins deposit disputes in Colorado. How to run both inspections so the deductions you make actually hold up.
- [Owning a Colorado Rental From Out of State: What Changes](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-out-of-state-landlord-colorado.html): Habitability deadlines, local contact requirements, licensing, taxes and the practical realities of owning Front Range rental property when you do not live here.
- [Pet Policies and Pet Screening for Colorado Rentals](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-pet-policy-screening-colorado.html): Pet rent, pet deposits, breed restrictions and screening. Why allowing pets usually makes money, and the one category that is not a pet at all.
- [The Property Management Agreement: What to Read Before Signing](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-property-management-agreement.html): Fee structures, termination clauses, maintenance authority, leasing fees and the terms that decide whether the relationship works. A clause-by-clause guide for owners.
- [How Much Does Property Management Cost in Denver? (2026 Fee Guide)](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-property-management-cost-denver.html): A transparent breakdown of property management fees in the Denver metro for 2026 — typical percentages, leasing and renewal fees, hidden costs to watch, and how to tell if a manager is worth it.
- [10 Questions to Ask a Denver Property Management Company](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-questions-to-ask-property-manager.html): The 10 questions every Denver-metro owner should ask before hiring a property manager — licensing, tenant screening, fees, contracts, communication, and compliance.
- [Rent Collection for Colorado Landlords: What Actually Works](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-rent-collection-colorado.html): Payment methods, grace periods, what to do on day one of lateness, partial payments and when to stop waiting. A practical system rather than a policy.
- [Rental Property Tax Deductions Landlords Can Write Off (2026)](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-rental-property-tax-deductions.html): A plain-English guide to rental property tax deductions — mortgage interest, repairs vs. improvements, depreciation, management fees, and the $25,000 loss allowance. Not tax advice; consult a CPA.
- [Can a Colorado Landlord Require Renters Insurance?](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-renters-insurance-colorado.html): What renters insurance covers, whether you can require it in a Colorado lease, how to verify it, and why the liability coverage matters more to you than the contents coverage.
- [Section 8 in Colorado: Landlords Can No Longer Refuse Vouchers](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-section-8-colorado-landlords.html): Colorado prohibits source-of-income discrimination in housing. What that means for landlords, how the voucher process actually works, and the economics owners consistently get wrong.
- [Should I Sell or Rent My House? A Denver Owner's Framework](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-sell-or-rent-your-house-denver.html): A structured way to compare selling against renting a Denver-area home — the numbers that matter, the tax rule with a deadline, and the honest questions about temperament.
- [Selling a Rental With Tenants in Colorado](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-selling-rental-with-tenants-colorado.html): The lease survives the sale. What that means for showings, notice, the security deposit and your buyer pool — and how to sell without a dispute.
- [Service Animals and ESAs in Colorado Rentals: Landlord Rules](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-service-animals-colorado-rentals.html): Assistance animals are not pets, and pet rules do not apply to them. What you may ask, what you may not, and how to handle a request without creating a fair housing problem.
- [Squatters' Rights in Colorado: What Owners Actually Face](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-squatters-rights-colorado.html): Adverse possession, unauthorized occupants and holdover tenants are three different problems with three different answers. What a Colorado owner can and cannot do.
- [How to Screen Tenants in Colorado: Laws, Steps & Red Flags](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-tenant-screening-colorado.html): A practical, Fair Housing-compliant guide to tenant screening in Colorado — what to check, who to call, red flags to watch for, and the state rules landlords need to know.
- [What Tenant Turnover Actually Costs a Colorado Landlord](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-tenant-turnover-cost.html): Vacancy, make-ready, marketing, screening and lost rent add up to far more than most owners estimate. The arithmetic — and what actually keeps good tenants.
- [Thornton & Northglenn Rental Market 2026: Rents & Outlook](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-thornton-northglenn-rental-market-2026.html): Current Thornton and Northglenn rent data for 2026, why one market keeps climbing while the other cools, and how north-metro landlords should price this year.
- [Colorado's Warranty of Habitability: A Landlord's Obligations](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-warranty-of-habitability-colorado.html): What makes a Colorado rental habitable, what happens when a tenant gives notice of a problem, and why the response deadline matters more than the repair itself.
- [Westminster & Arvada Rental Market 2026: Rents & Outlook](https://www.homeremediespm.com/blog-westminster-arvada-rental-market-2026.html): Updated September 2026: where Westminster and Arvada rents stand now, why the two markets are diverging, and how to price your rental accordingly.
